title: Answers in seconds
body: Reply resolves the questions your team answers fifty times a week — where's my order, can I change the address, how do I reset this — the minute they land.
imageAlt: A painterly meadow of teal and seafoam brushstrokes

title: Learns from what you've written
body: It reads your help centre and every ticket you have ever closed. Nothing to label, no flows to draw, no six-week onboarding.
imageAlt: Close-up painterly cream and blush cosmos petals

title: Knows when to step back
body: Anything angry, unusual, or expensive goes to a person — with the thread summarised, the account open, and a draft already waiting.
imageAlt: Painterly sage grasses bending in the wind
